title: Luxuriant Silky Venezuelan Tarragon Bowl
description: A peppery and indulgent Venezuelan dish featuring tarragon leaves, served in a Korean brass bowl, this recipe is macrobiotic friendly and offers a deep fried twist.
instructions: Rinse the tarragon leaves and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Cut the tofu into small cubes and season with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep fry the tofu cubes until golden brown and set aside.
Slice the onion and bell pepper into thin strips.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the same frying pan and cook until tender.
Mince the garlic and add it to the frying pan, cooking for an additional minute.
Add the rice vinegar and water to the frying pan, stirring to combine.
Add the deep fried tofu and tarragon leaves to the frying pan, stirring gently to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the mixture in a Korean brass bowl.
